newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia ASKO to raise capital to 100 bn rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia ASKO to raise capital to 100 bn rbls.

text.p: Russia's first private insurance company Strakhovaya Kompaniya ASKO will raise its authorised capital to 100 billion roubles from two billion roubles, its chairman said on Tuesday.
"We have already attracted all the investors, and currently we are talking to small ones," Andrei Drobinin told a news conference.
He said a final list of new owners would be announced in 30 days and they would include Swiss and German companies.
Currently Gruppa Suprimex, led by medium-sized Suprimexbank, owns a controlling stake in ASKO.
"The planned investment can cut its share significantly, but Suprimex is not going to sell any of its shares," it said in a statement.
ASKO's total insurance liability is now 1.5 trillion roubles and it has over 100,000 clients, it said in a statement.
